tokensGap: RadioX defines its tokens in radiox/apps/frontend/index.css (@theme static block, verified by apps/frontend/styles/tokens.test.ts); there is no packages/ui in the RadioX repo (packages/ui only contains node_modules) and apps/frontend/styles holds modal.css, runtimeAnimations.css, performanceClasses.ts. Not represented in Atlas foundation.json / brand roles: (1) Semantic content-tone roles: --color-onair (live), --color-ai, --color-community, --color-news, --color-dna beyond Atlas success/warning/info/destructive; Atlas would need at least a 'live' and a 'highlight' role (or documented mapping to chart-1..5). (2) Layered surface scale --color-surface-0/-card/-1/-2/-3 and --color-line/--color-line-strong (Atlas has card/muted/border only; foundation.mjs derives surface-info/success/warning/danger tints but no neutral elevation steps). (3) Foreground ramp --color-fg/-fg-2/-fg-3/-fg-4 with an explicit 'smallest label' floor (Atlas: foreground + muted-foreground only). (4) --color-scrim rgb(0 0 0/.7) for text/badges over imagery (no Atlas token). (5) Type roles --text-micro 11px, --text-meta 12px, --text-body 14px, --text-title 16px, --text-h1 24px, --text-hero clamp(28-44px) with paired line-heights (Atlas fontSize starts at xs 12px, no fluid hero clamp, no per-size line-height). (6) --tracking-caps 0.16em letter-spacing (Atlas has no letterSpacing scale). (7) Component radii --radius-chip 6px, --radius-inset 12px, --radius-card 16px, --radius-pill (Atlas: generic sm..xl/full derived from --brand-radius, no role names). (8) z-index roles header 40 / bar 45 / sheet 50 / modal 60 / toast 70 plus FloatingLayer 55 (Atlas zIndex: base/sticky/dropdown/overlay/modal/toast/tooltip, no persistent-bar or sheet level). (9) Shell geometry vars --rx-safe-top/--rx-safe-bottom (safe-area), --rx-nav-top/-height/-gap/-offset (+md), --rx-fixed-header-height/-gap/-offset, --rx-shell-max 1920/2400px, --rx-shell-side-gutter (Atlas layout tokens have no safe-area or wide-shell max). (10) Motion: --ease-out cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), durations 150/250/600 ms, modal keyframes rx-modal-arrive (260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)) / rx-modal-dim, loader/transition keyframes in runtimeAnimations.css (rx-loader-wave/matrix/bounce, rx-boot-scan, rx-transition-sweep/pill) – Atlas has duration instant..deliberate and easing standard/enter/exit but no named keyframes or spring/sheet curves. (11) Glass material tokens: --gp-tint/--gp-sheen/--gp-glow (.rx-glass-play) and modal materials glass/soft/flat with --rx-modal-light/-secondary/-ink/-muted (Atlas has only --brand-shadow; no blur/material tokens). (12) Scrollbar tokens --rx-scrollbar-thumb/-hover. (13) Brand ramp --color-brand-50..950 (cyan) – belongs in a RadioX brand JSON palette, not core. (14) Selection color ::selection rgba(34,211,238,.35). Recommendation: add to foundation.json 'letterSpacing' {caps}, fontSize 'micro', zIndex 'bar'/'sheet'/'floating', layout 'shellMax', easing 'emphasized' and a 'material' group (blur, glass tint opacity); add brand colorKeys 'live', 'scrim' (and optionally 'highlight') to brand.schema.json with contrast tests; map content-specific tones (ai/news/dna/community) in a RadioX brand file (packages/brands/src/radiox.json) if RadioX should consume Atlas.

Constraints for any import into Atlas core:
- tests/brands.test.mjs fails if packages/core/src contains next/, framer-motion, supabase or organisation names. RadioX uses neither framer-motion nor next, but SpaLink and LiveDot depend on RadioX hooks (usePathname/navigate, useCarMode), so strip those.
- AGENTS.md forbids brand hex values, logos and fonts in core. Every RadioX hardcode (cyan-400/500 glows, #050505 ring offset, slate/white-alpha surfaces, the hex field in statusTone, GeneratedMiniCover PALETTES, the SwissFlag colours) has to become a semantic token or brand-package data.
- Atlas cn uses tailwind-merge. RadioX cn is clsx only, so class conflicts behave differently. Check variant classes after porting.
- Atlas runs on Radix. Do not port RadioX's own overlay engines (useModalDialog, FloatingLayer, the Tooltip collision code, MiniBarMoreMenu, LanguageSwitcher dropdown). Atlas already covers them (dialog, popover, tooltip, dropdown-menu). Port only the behaviours Radix lacks: touch swipe-to-dismiss, drawer/immersive presentation, safe-area geometry and the promise-based confirm.

Primitives Atlas is missing that RadioX patterns need: Switch, Toggle/ToggleGroup (segmented control), RadioGroup, Avatar/AvatarGroup, Progress, Alert, Breadcrumb, Carousel, Spinner, Kbd, Stat, Stepper. All except Carousel come from the radix-ui package Atlas already uses. Carousel needs embla-carousel-react and embla-carousel-autoplay.
